chunks: He said: Ali (peace be upon him) took it out to the people when he had completed it and written it down, and said to them:
This is the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, as Allah sent it down upon Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and I have gathered it between the two boards.
They said: Here it is with us, a comprehensive Codex in which the Qur'an is gathered; we have no need of it.
He said: By Allah, you will not see it after this day of yours ever,
It was only (an obligation) upon me to inform you after gathering it so that you recite (from) it.

key_terms.اللَّوْحَيْنِ: The two boards (referring to the two wooden halves of the writing tablet)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his compiled Codex and the people's response?
ai.summary: This narration describes how Imam Ali (peace be upon him) presented his compiled Codex (Mushaf) to the people after writing it down, claiming it was the complete Book of Allah as revealed to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). The people responded that they already possessed their own comprehensive Codex containing the Qur'an and had no need for his, to which Ali declared that they would not see it again after that day, implying its eventual disappearance or obscurity. He concluded by stating his duty was merely to inform them so they could recite from it.

en.ammaar-muslim: He (i.e. the Imam) said: Ali عليه السلام took it (i.e. the Codex) out to the people when he had completed it and written it down and said to them:
This is the Book of Allah Mighty and Majestic as it was sent down by Allah upon Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله - I have gathered it between the two boards.
They said: We do have a Codex in which the Qur’an has been gathered - we do not have any need of it!
He said: By Allah - you will not see it after this day of yours ever!
It was only (an obligation) upon me to inform you after gathering it so that you recite (from) it
